verdict.rationale: Kling publishes a per-unit USD price table for each generation type (mode, duration, audio), so a marketer can work out a generation's cost before running it. Failed generations are documented as not consuming credits. There is no evidence of an in-product cost estimate at generation time, or of any usage, spend-history or balance dashboard for tracking spend afterwards. Missing for 10: in-app pre-run credit/dollar cost preview, post-run spend tracking or usage history, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: all prices below are USD per unit of generation
Image to Video (start/end frame) | pro, 5 seconds, no audio | $0.35
Text to Video / Image to Video | pro, 5 seconds, with audio + voice control | $0.84
Failed generations do not consume credits.
